anchors.description: Mattress long dimension: near-side top edge from the headboard-side corner to the visible foot corner of the bed.
anchors.visible_evidence: The bed's near-side top edge and bedding run continuously from the mattress corner at the headboard (left) to the foot corner at lower right; both endpoints sit on the mattress top boundary.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: US full (1.91 m) vs queen (2.03 m) mattress; the foot corner lies near the frame border and bedding overhang adds ~0.1 m; two-pillow width suggests a double/full bed.

anchors.description: Width of the left floral pillow's front face between its left and right edges.
anchors.visible_evidence: The left floral pillow's rectangular front face is fully visible against the headboard; endpoints lie on its left and right borders near mid-height.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Decorative sham could be a 26 in (0.66 m) standard pillow face; face edges are slightly soft, giving about +/-0.04 m.
